verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents its own retention control, ZeroTrace Mode, under which search parameters, files and data are not stored after a search completes. The docs also state a fixed 1-hour cache expiry. The evidence covers only a single pricing-page mention of the mode. Missing for 10: documented deletion of already-stored searches (e.g., Searches Archive entries), configurable retention periods, details on how and on which plans ZeroTrace is enabled, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: With ZeroTrace Mode enabled, we don't store your search parameters, files, or data. Once a search completes, it's as if it never happened.
